hero.title: How It Works
hero.description: We follow a structured and efficient operational methodology designed to reduce risk and launch your organization's call center with high levels of efficiency and professionalism.

step1.title: 1. Discovery Session & Requirements Analysis
step1.description: We understand your business, expected call volume, quality standards, and target communication channels to determine the right operational capacity.
outputs: Define the required team size and operational seats
Define the scope of work and Service Level Agreement (SLA)
Select the appropriate voice and written communication channels

step2.title: 2. Custom Configuration & Team Training
step2.description: Develop call scripts, integrate your systems with your CRM, and train the Saudi team dedicated to your account.
outputs: Develop customized call guides and scripts
Seamless integration with your CRM system
Train and prepare the dedicated operational team

step3.title: 3. Pilot Operation & Performance Measurement
step3.description: Launch a defined performance measurement period to validate response quality and resolution speed, with live reporting and adjustments before scaling.
outputs: Test cloud infrastructure and call stability
Provide daily and real-time performance reports
Optimize response scripts based on feedback

step4.title: 4. Go-Live & Scaling
step4.description: Transition to full production operations with dedicated operational oversight, regular quality reporting, and the ability to increase capacity immediately.
outputs: Launch and operate the call center 24/7
Provide regular analytical reports on policies and quality
Increase operational capacity with complete flexibility
